leadText: Bonnie (Japanese: ユリーカ Eureka) is a young girl introduced in Pokémon X and Y. She is the younger sister of Clemont.
plainText:
Bonnie (Japanese: ユリーカ Eureka) is a young girl introduced in Pokémon X and Y. She is the younger sister of Clemont.

==In the core series games==
 
Bonnie is present as an unwavering companion and supporter for her brother during his Gym battle with the player character. During the player's challenge of the Gym, she runs the quiz that the player must solve in order to challenge Clemont.

After defeating Clemont, Bonnie can be found on the first floor of the Lumiose Gym at Prism Tower. If talked to with a Pokémon with max Affection in front of the party, she will award the player with a .

Clemont and Bonnie do not appear in , though they are mentioned by some NPCs in Lumiose City. The Lumiose Gym was temporarily closed two years prior when Prism Tower was closed for renovations by Quasartico Inc..

===Quotes===
==== ====
Lumiose City
"Aren't you done yet?"
"Oh, Shauna! And you are...a challenger? Sorry, but could you wait a moment? C'mon, Clemont!"
"Yeah. Right. Whatever... There are challengers waiting for you, you know. Prism Tower itself is Lumiose City's Pokémon Gym!"

Lumiose Gym
Upon entry to the 2F of the Gym
"Ah! You're that Trainer from before! Come straight for a battle, have you? Well, good! You can call me Bonnie. I'm this Gym Leader's younger sister. Go ahead and step onto that small square a few steps directly ahead of you, would you? You will have to answer my questions if you want to get any farther ahead!"

If talked to or if trying to talk to other Gym Trainers
"Please stand in the answering area!"

After standing in the answering area for the 2F
"Quiz time! Who's that Pokémon?!"
"1. Emolga. 2. Dedenne
3. Pikachu"
"Go talk to the Trainer who's the same number as the right answer!"

After standing in the answering area for the 3F
"Quiz time! Who's that Pokémon?!"
"1. Fletchling. 2. Pidgey
3. Taillow"
"Go talk to the Trainer who's the same number as the right answer!"

After standing in the answering area for the 4F
"Quiz time! Who's that Pokémon?!"
"1. Pansage. 2. Pansear
3. Panpour"
"Go talk to the Trainer who's the same number as the right answer!"

After standing in the answering area for the 5F
"Quiz time! Which one is Vivillon? Is it No. 1, is it No. 2, or is it No. 3?"
"Go talk to the Trainer who's the same number as the right answer!"

If talked to
"If you want to hear the question again, step on the small panel!"

After defeating a Trainer
"Then step into the elevator!"

If a wrong answer is selected
"Buzz! Too bad, so sad! That was obviously the wrong answer! I guess you'll have to fight another Trainer."

If the correct answer is selected
"Ding-ding-ding! You're correct! Well, aren't you a clever one!"

Before battling Clemont
"This is the Gym Leader of Lumiose City, Clemont! You'd better watch out! My brother's strong! As strong as you'd expect a Lumiose City Gym Leader to be, got it?"
"I know, I know! Anyway, I hope you two have an awesome battle!"

After defeating Clemont
"M-my brother... You lost?"
"Oh, I know! I know this one! It's TM24! That's ! It has a power of 90 and its accuracy is 100 percent! It'll never miss! It's a really popular move because of that!"

If talked to afterwards
 
"You're a pretty amazing Pokémon Trainer, huh? Keep whipping my bro into shape! He needs it!"

After exiting and re-entering the tower after defeating Clemont
"Oh, you and are..."
(Pokémon with no or one Affection heart)
"Sort of friends, perhaps? Am I right?"
(Pokémon with two hearts)
"Becoming good friends! I can tell!"
(Pokémon with three hearts)
"Pretty good friends! Can I pet it?"
(Pokémon with four hearts)
"Really good friends! I want to play with it!"
(Pokémon with max Affection)
"Really, really good friends! I want to give it Poké Puffs and play with it! (receive Ribbon) Please cherish your friendship forever and ever!"
(Pokémon with max Affection after receiving Ribbon)
"Really, really good friends! I can tell you've poured your love into it so much! How wonderful!"

===Sprites and models===
 

==In animation==
 
 
Bonnie appears in Pokémon the Series: XY as a for alongside and her brother . She and Clemont first met Ash in Kalos, Where Dreams and Adventures Begin!, but they officially began traveling with him in A Battle of Aerial Mobility!. She also reappeared in Pokémon Journeys: The Series for a two-part episode set in Kalos.
 

==In the manga==
 
===Pokémon Adventures===
Bonnie debuted in Charging After Electrike. She was first seen entering the Prism Tower, only to find the aftermath of a between and the Lumiose Press editor-in-chief, a member of Team Flare. To her shock, Bonnie noticed an that helped keep the tower active during a blackout had gone missing. She then went off to inform Clemont about what happened.

In Zygarde Agitated, Bonnie, Clemont, Alexa, Viola, and Yvette confronted Team Flare at . Together, the group managed to successfully free the Pokémon Team Flare had captured. After Team Flare was fully defeated, Bonnie and her allies met with X and his friends at Lumiose City to congratulate them on their victory. She and Clemont also returned Furry, 's missing , to its Trainer.

==In the TCG==
 
 
Bonnie was introduced as a in the Pokémon Trading Card Game during the English Sun & Moon Series (the Japanese SM Era). It was first released in the Japanese expansion before debuting in English in the , with the background artwork by Hideki Ishikawa. It was also released as a in Forbidden Light, with an illustration by the same artist. If there is any in play, this card allows the player to discard that Stadium card and to use 's GX attack even if the player has used a GX attack already.
